other_conditions: Must have passed HSC with at least 60% marks from a BSE Odisha, CBSE, ICSE, or equivalent board
Must be pursuing regular Class XI (10+2) courses
Must be a permanent resident of Odisha
Must apply in the first year of the course (Class XI) through the State Scholarship Portal
Application must be validated/authenticated by the concerned higher secondary school/institute
benefits_summary: Students receive a scholarship of ₹3000 per year for Class XI & XII, with up to 10,000 scholarships allotted (boys and girls in a 50:50 ratio).
